summary: Sonic Finance rebrand + receipt-upload + daily-summary-email features fully tested. Backend: 30/30 pytest pass (22 regression + 8 new: receipt upload/serve with auth+404+bad-ext, cron daily-summary with Bearer secret from backend/.env, admin-only /api/reports/email-summary with 403 for finance_user). Real Emergent Resend integration confirmed via httpx logs: POST /api/v1/email/send returned 202 Accepted (3x) during the test run. Frontend: login page shows 'Masuk ke Sonic Finance', /sonic-finance-logo.png returns 200 image/png, sidebar brand renders 'Sonic Finance'. Expenses > Petty Cash upload flow works end-to-end: file input -> thumbnail preview in form -> submit -> row shows receipt-thumb -> click opens the image in new tab as authenticated blob. Same works on Credit Purchase tab. Admin sees email-summary-btn on Reports page, click triggers success toast ('Ringkasan terkirim ke email pemilik'); finance_user does NOT see the button. All done via external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with httpOnly cookies.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 836 lines mixing auth, CRUD, uploads, email, cron. Consider splitting into routers/*.py (auth, expenses, purchases, uploads, reports, cron) for maintainability.

GET /api/files/{path:path} calls get_current_user manually to preserve the path parameter; the current implementation is fine but the endpoint bypasses Depends so any future middleware would need to be re-applied here.

storage.init_storage uses a module-level _storage_key with no lock; harmless because writes are idempotent, but two concurrent workers can double-init. Consider asyncio.Lock/threading.Lock or lazy fetch on 401/404 only.

email_service.send_email swallows exceptions and returns None; the caller (_run_daily_summary) does not check the return value, so a Resend failure would silently drop the email. Consider logging.warn + optional retry, and surfacing status in POST /api/reports/email-summary response.

receipt files metadata (db.files) never gets cleaned up if the referencing expense/purchase is deleted. Consider a soft-delete on receipt_path when parent doc is deleted, or an admin housekeeping endpoint.
generic crud() for master data still lacks role protection on POST/PUT/DELETE for products/branches/vendors/menus (pre-existing item from iteration_1).
